title: Solventum Appoints Two New Independent Directors to Its Board of Directors

body_markdown:
*Addition of two independent directors brings healthcare leadership and investment* *expertise to support Solventum's continued transformation*


EAGAN, Minn.


, Nov. 24, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Solventum (NYSE: SOLV) today announced the appointment of two new independent directors, Steven H. Collis, former Chair, President and Chief Executive Officer of Cencora, Inc., a global healthcare distribution company, and Hassan A. Elmasry, Co-Founder and former Managing Partner and Lead Portfolio Manager of Independent Franchise Partners, LLP, a global investment management firm, to its Board of Directors, effective immediately.


Mr. Collis has more than 30 years of healthcare executive experience, including leading a large, complex healthcare organization and executing through change, and has been appointed as a Class II director, with a term expiring at the 2028 Annual Meeting. Mr. Elmasry brings nearly four decades of investment experience and a strong understanding of capital allocation, strategy and long-term value creation, and has been appointed as a Class III director, with a term expiring at the 2027 Annual Meeting. With these appointments the Board now comprises 14 members, 13 of whom are independent.


"We are pleased to welcome Steve and Hassan to the Solventum Board. Steve brings extensive executive experience leading a global healthcare company through a period of significant growth and value creation, while Hassan brings deep expertise in capital allocation and a proven track record as a long-term investor," said Carrie Cox, Chair of the Solventum Board of Directors. "Together they will provide the Board with complementary experience, additive skills and valuable perspective as we continue our work overseeing Solventum's transformation and driving shareholder value."


In connection with the appointments, Mr. Collis will serve on the Talent and Science, Technology and Quality committees, and Mr. Elmasry will serve on the Audit Committee.


"The experience and insight that Steve and Hassan bring to the Board will be important contributors to our ongoing transformation and as we advance toward becoming a more focused MedTech company," said Bryan Hanson, Chief Executive Officer of Solventum. "The management team and I look forward to working together with Steve, Hassan and the full Board to continue delivering on our plan, serving our customers and creating value for shareholders."


**About Steven H. Collis** Steven H. Collis is the former Executive Chair of Cencora, Inc., a global healthcare distribution company, where he previously served as Chair, President and Chief Executive Officer. Over more than 30 years at Cencora and its predecessor companies, Mr. Collis held leadership roles in specialty healthcare distribution and operations, helping expand the company's global presence and capabilities. He currently serves on the Board of Directors of Elevance Health, Inc., where he is a member of the Audit and Finance Committees, and previously served on the boards of Cencora (and its predecessor company AmerisourceBergen Corporation), Bausch + Lomb Corporation and Thoratec Corporation, a medical device company acquired by St. Jude Medical. Mr. Collis holds a Bachelor of Commerce and a postgraduate Bachelor of Commerce Honours degree from the University of the Witwatersrand in Johannesburg, South Africa, and qualified as a Chartered Accountant in South Africa.


**About Hassan A. Elmasry** Hassan A. Elmasry is the Co-Founder and former Managing Partner and Lead Portfolio Manager of Independent Franchise Partners, LLP, a global investment management firm with more than $21 billion of assets under management, which he helped establish in 2009. Previously, he served as a Managing Director and portfolio manager at Morgan Stanley Investment Management, where he led its Global Franchise investment strategy. Earlier in his career, he held investment roles at Mitchell Hutchins Asset Management and First Chicago Corporation. He holds a Master of Business Administration and Bachelor of Arts degree in Economics from the University of Chicago.


**About Solventum**
At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers' toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better — while empowering healthcare professionals to perform at their best.
